item.title: Hajjar Baban
item.description: Hajjar Baban natalie_wollenzien Tue, 02/03/2026 - 3:57pm Hajjar Baban is a Pakistan-born Afghan Kurdish poet. Her work appears in publications including Prairie Schooner, Guernica, Poetry Daily, and Hayden’s Ferry Review, where she won the 2025 Poetry Contest, selected by Hieu Minh Nguyen. Recipient of a Pushcart Prize in Poetry, Baban is also a cofounder of the Kurdish Poets Collective. LOW FLYING PLANES is her first full-length book of poems.

item.title: Zineb Mekouar
item.description: Zineb Mekouar natalie_wollenzien Thu, 02/05/2026 - 10:26am Zineb Mekouar was born in Casablanca, Morocco. She studied at the French international school Lycée Lyautey and later graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Mekouar was nominated for the First Novel Award by the renowned French literary organization Goncourt Academy. Remember the Bees was awarded the Mouans-Sartoux Award, the Folire Prize, and the Académie Française Henri de Régnier Prize. She lives in Paris.

item.title: Maren Baudet-Lackner
item.description: Maren Baudet-Lackner natalie_wollenzien Thu, 02/05/2026 - 10:28am Maren Baudet-Lackner is an American literary translator from the French. She has published a dozen titles with major imprints in the United Kingdom and United States and is the recipient of multiple PEN Awards. She has also received Albertine Translation grants for her work. Baudet-Lackner holds advanced degrees from Yale University and the Sorbonne and lives near Paris with her family.
